description: Artefact verification only re-hashed what a build had recorded, so a build that silently lost the wheel verified clean and printed RESULT: VERIFIED for a set with no wheel in it. Verification now also confirms every required kind was produced. It has to distinguish an explicit opt-out from a silent loss, so the required kinds are chosen by the build, persisted in artifacts.json, and a FAILED build step is fatal while a SKIPPED one is not.
